about: Gmail is the recipient's mailbox, not a service an app integrates: an app reaches it through its sending provider. Maya Okafor makes her Google account at Google's sign-up (googleoauth, which Gmail requires: its accounts are Gmail's mailboxes); Harbourline's Rallly, through the unchanged nodemailer at Rallly's pin (^10.0.1, packages/emails/package.json at 3e63239dbdec), sends a finalized poll's notice through Harbourline's relay (the smtp twin the entry uses, named in twins: a Gmail customer may send this way and need not; the SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT and SMTP_SECURE the World injects, no authentication at boot) to the address Maya gave it, maya.okafor+rallly@gmail.com, asserting it accepted and none rejected. The relay hands it to Gmail (twin-world ADR 0032), which keeps it in the account the address tags. The MX host reached directly from an app (gmail-smtp-in.l.google.com) is not this entry: no application integrates it.
